thesis_summary.thesis: Bitdeer Technologies is a Singapore-headquartered operator of bitcoin mining and AI computing infrastructure listed on Nasdaq as BTDR. **[Fact]** The company runs ten datacenters across the United States, Norway, Bhutan, Ethiopia, and Malaysia with **1,744 megawatts** of electrical capacity as of March 31, 2026. **[Fact]** Proprietary hash rate was **70.9 exahash per second** and total hash rate under management was **78.1 EH/s** on that date. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$620.3 million**, up from **$349.8 million** in FY2024, driven by self-mining (**$396 million**, 64% of revenue) and the first full year of proprietary **SEALMINER** rig sales (**$108 million**, 18%). **[Fact]** The company also offers hosting, cloud hash rate, and an early AI cloud business (**$6.8 million** revenue in FY2025 with **2,128 GPUs** deployed at **94% utilization** as of March 31, 2026).
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** complexity discount (GAAP earnings and operating cash flow are dominated by convertible-derivative marks, SEALMINER inventory build, and an unproven AI pivot).
